theorems.name: Submission.cbrr_uniform_density_on_large_set
theorems.statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (M : Set (Euclid P)) (Q : Euclid P → Submodule ℝ (Euclid P)), 0 < n → MeasurableSet M → μHE[n] M ≠ ∞ → AEStronglyMeasurable (fun x => (Q x).starProjection) (μHE[n].restrict M) → (∀ᵐ x ∂(μHE[n].restrict M), HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt n M x (Q x)) → ∀ (a b ε : ℝ), ENNReal.ofReal a < unitBallVolume n → 0 < b → 0 < ε → ∃ (E : Set (Euclid P)) (δ : ℝ), E ⊆ M ∧ 0 < δ ∧ μHE[n] (M \ E) < ENNReal.ofReal ε ∧ (∀ x ∈ E, Module.finrank ℝ (Q x) = n) ∧ (∀ y ∈ E, ∀ ρ : ℝ, 0 < ρ → ρ < δ → ENNReal.ofReal (a * ρ ^ n) ≤ (μHE[n].restrict M) (closedBall y ρ)) ∧ ∀ x ∈ E, ∀ ρ : ℝ, 0 < ρ → ρ < δ → (μHE[n].restrict M) ({z | 2 * ‖(Q x).starProjection (z - x)‖ < ‖z - x‖} ∩ ball x ρ) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (b * ρ ^ n)
